edges.rationale: The difficulty of judging complex outputs without deep domain knowledge motivates the shift from absolute performance metrics to comparative evaluation.

edges.dependent: Lack of Standardization and Quality Control
edges.rationale: The inherent difficulty in evaluating intelligent outputs contributes to the absence of universal standards and quality control mechanisms.
The need for human evaluators with deep domain knowledge to judge complex outputs creates high cost and time constraints, leading to scalability bottlenecks.
